words: Deirdre next door asked me to get her some pepper – brown – she said – though she didn't say much else. Altogether I've 8600 US cents to spend – that's the whole lot, nothing more in the purse than that. Every item on the list has to be ready and waiting for me – not a single one missing from the lot, now. Her tomatoes are coming in like weeds – so she's in a proper cooking mood. Here's my list – 1 x pillow cases & bolster cases with a novelty pattern; 1 x protein powders in banana flavor; and 2 x pepper in the brown color family. I'll hand it over the fence after the school run today – she's busy with Sunday's dinner. Get the total down as far as it'll go. I'll only receive 3 messages from you - anything after that is turned away. We've 40 steps - then we're finished - done or not.
